scriptData.label: @effect.name
Roll to remove Stunned
Broken Arm (Minor)

description.label: Description
description.value:
The sling bullet slams into your right flank, breaking one of the lower ribs. The jagged end of it gets punched deep, where it lacerates one of your kidneys. As the kidneys’ job is to filtrate your entire blood volume over and over again, this is bad news indeed.

Effects: Gain @Condition[Stunned] (1) and @Condition[Bleeding] (3), the latter of which requires Surgery to remove. Should you survive, you’ll still have a Broken Bone (Minor). Because stopping the bleeding probably required clamping off the whole organ, you’ll incidentally also have only one kidney left…
